description.en: Mr Tyson grumbles about the rain, but on a grand day he's out on his vegetable patch: sun, cloud, wind and drizzle, and what the weather does to the garden.
description.sl: Gospod Tyson godrnja čez dež, ob lepem dnevu (a grand day) pa je na svoji zelenjavni gredi: sonce, oblaki, veter in pršec ter kaj vreme naredi z vrtom.
description.it: Il signor Tyson brontola per la pioggia, ma in una bella giornata (a grand day) è nel suo orto: sole, nuvole, vento e pioggerella, e che cosa fa il tempo all'orto.
description.de: Herr Tyson schimpft über den Regen, aber an einem schönen Tag (a grand day) ist er in seinem Gemüsebeet: Sonne, Wolken, Wind und Nieselregen, und was das Wetter mit dem Garten macht.

review: de, sl, en, it: machine-written, not reviewed by a native speaker

words.example_en: On the fells the weather changes every hour.
words.example_sl: V hribih se vreme spremeni vsako uro.
words.example_it: Sui monti il tempo cambia ogni ora.
words.example_de: Auf den Fells ändert sich das Wetter jede Stunde.
words.note: No a: the weather, never a weather. Whether (if) sounds the same.
words.note_sl: Brez a: the weather, nikoli a weather. Whether (ali) se izgovori enako.
words.note_it: Senza a: the weather, mai a weather. Whether (se) si pronuncia uguale.
words.note_de: Ohne a: the weather, nie a weather. Whether (ob) klingt gleich.

words.example_en: What's the weather like up on the fell?
words.example_sl: Kakšno je vreme gori v hribih?
words.example_it: Che tempo fa lassù sui monti?
words.example_de: Wie ist das Wetter oben auf dem Berg?
words.note: Like here doesn't mean to like: it asks what something is like, how it is.
words.note_sl: Like tu ne pomeni »imeti rad«: vpraša, kakšno je nekaj.
words.note_it: Qui like non vuol dire «piacere»: chiede com'è una cosa.
words.note_de: Like heißt hier nicht »mögen«: Es fragt, wie etwas ist.

words.example_en: It's raining again! Take your wellies.
words.example_it: Piove di nuovo! Prendi gli stivali di gomma.
words.example_de: Es regnet schon wieder! Nimm die Gummistiefel mit.
words.note: Weather verbs take it: it's raining, it's snowing. Rain is a noun too: the rain.
words.note_sl: Glagoli za vreme imajo it: it's raining, it's snowing. Rain je tudi samostalnik: the rain (dež).
words.note_it: I verbi del tempo hanno it: it's raining, it's snowing. Rain è anche un nome: the rain (la pioggia).
words.note_de: Wetterverben haben it: it's raining, it's snowing. Rain ist auch ein Nomen: the rain (der Regen).

words.example_en: It's only drizzle, we can still go out.
words.example_sl: Samo pršec je, še lahko gremo ven.
words.example_it: È solo pioggerella, possiamo uscire lo stesso.
words.example_de: Es ist nur Nieselregen, wir können trotzdem rausgehen.
words.note: Fine, light rain: the Lake District's favourite weather. A verb too: it's drizzling.
words.note_sl: Droben, rahel dež: najljubše vreme v Lake Districtu. Tudi glagol: it's drizzling (prši).
words.note_it: Pioggia fine e leggera: il tempo preferito del Lake District. Anche un verbo: it's drizzling (pioviggina).
words.note_de: Feiner, leichter Regen: das Lieblingswetter im Lake District. Auch ein Verb: it's drizzling (es nieselt).

words.example_en: There's a big black cloud over the fell.
words.example_sl: Nad hribom je velik črn oblak.
words.example_it: Sopra il monte c'è una grossa nuvola nera.
words.example_de: Über dem Berg hängt eine große schwarze Wolke.

words.example_en: The wind is very strong on the tops.
words.example_sl: Na vrhovih je veter zelo močan.
words.example_it: Sulle cime il vento è fortissimo.
words.example_de: Oben auf den Gipfeln ist der Wind sehr stark.
words.note: The tops: in Cumbria, the high fells.
words.note_sl: The tops: v Cumbrii najvišji hribi.
words.note_it: The tops: in Cumbria le cime dei monti.
words.note_de: The tops: in Cumbria die hohen Fells.

words.example_en: There's snow on the fells in winter.
words.example_it: D'inverno c'è la neve sui monti.
words.example_de: Im Winter liegt Schnee auf den Bergen.
words.note_de: Auch ein Verb: it's snowing (es schneit).

words.example_en: It's sunny, so let's walk up to the tarn.
words.example_sl: Sončno je, pojdimo do gorskega jezera.
words.example_it: C'è il sole, saliamo fino al laghetto.
words.example_de: Es ist sonnig, gehen wir zum Bergsee hinauf.
words.note: Weather words often end in -y: sun, sunny; cloud, cloudy; wind, windy.
words.note_sl: Pridevniki za vreme se pogosto končajo na -y: sun, sunny; cloud, cloudy; wind, windy.
words.note_it: Gli aggettivi del tempo finiscono spesso in -y: sun, sunny; cloud, cloudy; wind, windy.
words.note_de: Wetter-Adjektive enden oft auf -y: sun, sunny; cloud, cloudy; wind, windy.

words.example_en: It's cloudy this morning, but it'll be sunny later.
words.example_sl: Zjutraj je oblačno, pozneje pa bo sončno.
words.example_it: Stamattina è nuvoloso, ma più tardi ci sarà il sole.
words.example_de: Heute Morgen ist es bewölkt, aber später wird es sonnig.

words.example_en: It's windy: a good day for drying the washing.
words.example_sl: Vetrovno je: dober dan za sušenje perila.
words.example_it: C'è vento: una buona giornata per stendere il bucato.
words.example_de: Es ist windig: ein guter Tag zum Wäschetrocknen.
Mach die Tür zu, es ist eiskalt!
words.note: Very, very cold. Also: I'm freezing! (I'm very cold.)
words.note_sl: Zelo, zelo mrzlo. Tudi: I'm freezing! (Strašno me zebe!)
words.note_de: Sehr, sehr kalt. Auch: I'm freezing! (Ich friere!)

words.example_en: It's a grand day for the hay!
words.example_it: È una giornata perfetta per il fieno!
words.note: Northern English: fine, very good. That's grand! means that's fine.
words.note_sl: Severnoangleško: lep, zelo dober. That's grand! pomeni: v redu je.
words.note_it: Inglese del nord: bello, ottimo. That's grand! vuol dire: va benissimo.
words.note_de: Nordenglisch: schön, sehr gut. That's grand! heißt: Passt schon.

words.example_en: Look, a rainbow over the lake!
words.example_it: Guarda, un arcobaleno sopra il lago!
words.example_de: Schau, ein Regenbogen über dem See!
words.note: Rain and sun together: rain + bow.
words.note_sl: Dež in sonce hkrati: rain (dež) + bow (lok).
words.note_it: Pioggia e sole insieme: rain (pioggia) + bow (arco).
words.note_de: Regen und Sonne zusammen: rain (Regen) + bow (Bogen).

words.note: Informal British: a brolly. On the fells the wind takes it: wear a good coat instead!
words.note_sl: Pogovorno britansko: a brolly. V hribih ga odnese veter: raje obleci dobro jakno!
words.note_it: Britannico informale: a brolly. Sui monti il vento se lo porta via: meglio una buona giacca!
words.note_de: Umgangssprachlich britisch: a brolly. Auf den Fells nimmt ihn der Wind mit: lieber eine gute Jacke!

words.example_en: Mr Tyson grows potatoes and leeks in his vegetable patch.
words.example_sl: Gospod Tyson na zelenjavni gredi goji krompir in por.
words.example_it: Il signor Tyson coltiva patate e porri nel suo orto.
words.example_de: Herr Tyson baut in seinem Gemüsebeet Kartoffeln und Lauch an.
words.note: A small part of a garden for vegetables. A bigger plot outside the village: an allotment.
words.note_sl: Majhen del vrta za zelenjavo. Večji kos zemlje zunaj vasi: an allotment (vrtiček).
words.note_it: Un pezzetto di giardino per le verdure. Un appezzamento più grande fuori paese: an allotment (orto comunale).
words.note_de: Ein kleines Stück Garten für Gemüse. Ein größeres Stück Land außerhalb: an allotment (Schrebergarten).

words.example_en: No need to water the garden: it's raining again!
words.example_sl: Vrta ni treba zalivati: spet dežuje!
words.example_it: Non serve annaffiare l'orto: piove di nuovo!
words.example_de: Den Garten muss man nicht gießen: Es regnet schon wieder!
words.note: Water is a noun and a verb. A watering can: what you water with.
words.note_sl: Water je samostalnik in glagol. A watering can: zalivalka.
words.note_it: Water è nome e verbo. A watering can: l'annaffiatoio.
words.note_de: Water ist Nomen und Verb. A watering can: die Gießkanne.

words.example_en: After the rain the weeds grow so fast!
words.example_sl: Po dežju plevel raste tako hitro!
words.example_it: Dopo la pioggia le erbacce crescono così in fretta!
words.example_de: Nach dem Regen wächst das Unkraut so schnell!
words.note: One weed, many weeds. To weed: to pull them out.
words.note_sl: One weed, many weeds. To weed: pleti.
words.note_it: One weed, many weeds. To weed: togliere le erbacce.
words.note_de: One weed, many weeds. To weed: Unkraut jäten.
